_comment: Pre-existing shared-row writes on a hand's path that cannot be removed in incident 075013fd. Read by scripts/ci/check-hand-path-shared-writes.mjs; every entry names function, kind, target, owner, reason, date (tests/a-hands-money-path-never-writes-a-shared-row.law.test.ts). This list is DEBT: remove an entry in the change that removes the write. The 14 that #11270/#11266 remove (atomic_distribute_rake, bbj_record_contribution, fn_bbj_allocate, record_insurance_transaction, the envelope's bbj-pool lock and pool row, and through them trg_union_rake_weekly and fn_bbj_contribution_drops_cached_hours) are deliberately NOT here.
measured: 2026-11-18 read-only on production kuklfnapbkmacvwxktbh: 875 functions on the path, 37 violations before #11270/#11266, 23 after. With the SET-target rule (20261118160106: an UPDATE OF trigger is followed only when the statement SETs one of its columns) 726 functions and 12 violations: 11 were triggers that cannot fire (fn_apply_club_ladder, fn_sync_club_staff_notice_group, fn_refresh_club_activity_counts, fn_sync_club_table_counts, guard_member_club_standalone_game, fn_ca_fund_overlay_on_lock x4, fn_guard_tournament_start_readiness x2) and are removed. 20261118161644 (lane H1, installs on merge) then removes fn_ca_horse_split_return_late_credit row_lock/write clubs and fn_ca_deleted_wallet_bank_return write clubs (proved on production texts by scripts/ci/test-hand-path-cash-lane.py); the last two lane-H1 entries go when 20261118161703 installs in the daily window. Lane H2 (#11311) re-reasoned its fn_ca_burn and spin entries (STATIC ONLY, G3 native proof).

entries.reason: STATIC ONLY, PROVEN UNREACHABLE FOR THIS ROW (lane H2, 2026-11-18). The chain is real up to fn_ca_burn: a Diamond Arena BBJ credit (fn_poker_diamond_jackpot_pay -> add_diamonds_to_balance) to a player with an open diamond_debts receivable writes a NEGATIVE debt_settlement row, which fires trg_allocate_lifetime_vip_diamond_spend (WHEN new.amount < 0) -> expire_lifetime_vip_diamond_lots_for_user, and an overdue Lifetime VIP lot is burned through fn_ca_burn('diamonds', 'player', ...). That branch locks and writes only the player's profiles row; the clubs / union_wallets lock and write sit in fn_ca_burn's CHIPS branch (v_asset = 'chips' AND v_src IN ('club','union')), which the expiry's literal arguments never select. The reader cannot see literal arguments. Production 2026-11-18: 0 jackpot hits ever, 0 open diamond debts, 0 overdue lots, 0 VIP expiry burns. Native proof: scripts/ci/test-hand-path-shared-writes.py G3 diamond (the real production texts complete while another session holds the club and union wallet rows; a chip burn waits on them). Remove when fn_ca_burn's diamond retirement is its own function the expiry calls.

entries.owner: club-arena hand path lane H1 (incident 075013fd): remove after 20261118161703 installs
entries.reason: Reached only through a clubs.chip_treasury write (the deleted-wallet and horse-split bank returns, NOWAIT since 20261118161644, and fn_ca_burn) firing trg_union_totals_follow_club_counts, a STATEMENT trigger on every clubs UPDATE whose body recomputes the union ladder only when member/admin/super-agent/agent counts changed, which a bank write never does. 20261118161703 (daily-window install: it replaces a trigger on clubs) makes it a row trigger on UPDATE OF the four count columns WHEN one changed. Remove this entry once 20261118161703 is installed.

entries.reason: Since 20261118161644 the hand's member-credit trigger takes the club bank NOWAIT (fn_ca_deleted_wallet_bank_return_nowait); this entry is only the NAME edge left: fn_ca_deleted_wallet_credit also serves account deletion (profiles), whose branch calls the blocking fn_ca_deleted_wallet_bank_return (4 s wait, right for deletion). 20261118161703 (daily-window install: it repoints the profiles trigger) moves that branch to fn_ca_deleted_profile_bank_return. Remove this entry once 20261118161703 is installed.

STATIC ONLY, PROVEN UNREACHABLE ON A HAND (lane H2, 2026-11-18). The hand's only left_at write is fn_ca_settle_hand_stacks_absolute's zero-stack VACATE of a tournament seat; trg_seat_change_syncs_seat_first_count then runs fn_sync_seat_first_player_count, which books the Spin (and locks the union/club spin_bonus_pools row) only when live seats >= max_players. A vacate strictly lowers the count from <= max_players, so a hand can never satisfy it; the booking belongs to the third paid seat's fill. Production: 782 of 782 spin contributions in the 7 days to 2026-11-18 were booked before their spin's first hand commit (0 inside or after one). Native proof: scripts/ci/test-hand-path-shared-writes.py G3 spin (production seat-first texts + the hand's verbatim seat/roster statements commit while another session holds the spin pool, club and union wallet rows; a third-seat fill waits on the pool). The reader cannot evaluate the count guard. Remove when the booking leaves the seat-count trigger for the fill's own path.
